words.exampleSentence: A borboleta voa de flor em flor no jardim.
words.exampleTranslation: The butterfly flies from flower to flower in the garden.

words.exampleSentence: Tenho muitas saudades dos meus amigos de infância.
words.exampleTranslation: I miss my childhood friends very much.
words.funFact: 'Saudade' is famous as one of the most culturally distinctive Portuguese words, expressing deep nostalgic longing.

words.exampleSentence: As estrelas brilham no céu noturno.
words.exampleTranslation: The stars shine in the night sky.

words.exampleSentence: Não te esqueças do guarda-chuva, hoje vai chover.
words.exampleTranslation: Don't forget your umbrella, it is going to rain today.

words.exampleSentence: Gosto de caminhar na praia de madrugada.
words.exampleTranslation: I like walking on the beach at dawn.

words.exampleSentence: O sol aquece a cidade pela manhã.
words.exampleTranslation: The sun warms the city in the morning.

words.exampleSentence: A mãe fez um cafuné suave na criança antes de dormir.
words.exampleTranslation: The mother gently ran her fingers through the child's hair before bedtime.
words.funFact: This affectionate word comes from the rich African cultural influence on the Portuguese language.

words.exampleSentence: Visitámos o Castelo de São Jorge em Lisboa.
words.exampleTranslation: We visited the Castle of Saint George in Lisbon.

words.exampleSentence: O girassol vira-se em direção à luz do sol.
words.exampleTranslation: The sunflower turns towards the sunlight.

words.exampleSentence: A esperança dá-nos força para seguir em frente.
words.exampleTranslation: Hope gives us strength to move forward.
